title: 第二十三章入府第五名额候选者第二十四章拳法精通
content_zh:
;;
沧浪武馆。
前院。
众人此时随着王进的宣布，也彻底炸开了锅。
“巡察府竟然是真的，我之前就听到我父亲谈过，没想到竟然是真的！”
“这巡查府权力也太大了吧！监察万民，巡视天下，先斩后奏，一旦加入，岂不是立刻成为人上人？”
“那是自然！一旦加入，必然是各方势力的座上宾！而且加入巡查府可是能得成就练血宗师，养神大宗师的无上秘法啊！甚至能得到那位武圣的指点！这诱惑太大了！”
“诱惑大有什么用？今年年底，州府郡县都必须成立，老师更是说，三个月内五禽拳大成，武道入品才有资格加入。你能做到吗？还是我能做到？”
“是啊！老师告知我们这番机遇，想来不过是激励我们努力学武，给我们一个希望。”
议论纷纷后，众人顿时有些沮丧。
突然间。
有人开口道：“我知道有人有希望？”
“谁？”
“程然师兄！”
此话一出，众人扭头看向程然。
而此刻，程然面带微笑，似乎很享受被众人关注的目光。
那人继续道：“程然师兄气血早已圆满，并且鹤虎两势皆已至小成！三个月内拳法突破未必没有希望，武道入品对程师兄来说更是不难！”
听到这番话，众人更是惊讶的看向面带微笑的程然。
就在这时。
一位身处白色宽松练功服，满头的黑发用红色束带简单一系，一副气宇轩昂的男子走出来。

“在下萧鹏，见过老师！”男子朝着王进微微作揖行礼。
“何事？”王进开口。
萧鹏拱手道：“弟子已于一周前领悟了虎形拳的神与形，虎形拳臻至大成之境。并且气血已然大成，即将圆满！，猿形拳也已入小成之境。”
说话间，萧鹏神采飞扬，嘴角微翘。
此刻他身上气血充盈，身形赫然爆发出一股淡淡的气势，给四周众人一股压迫感。
“天呐！萧师兄竟然不知不觉走到这一步？”有人惊呼。
“是啊！萧师兄果然是不鸣则已，一鸣惊人啊！一周前就臻至虎形拳大成之境，竟然能隐忍不说，直到今日才说出来！”
“虎形拳大成，猿形拳小成，气血大成贯通四肢，这岂不是说剩下那個名额已然被萧鹏师兄提前锁定？”
“如此来看是的，程然师兄虽然有机会，但是明显略逊一筹，拳法大成和小成之间有不可逾越的鸿沟！”
“没错！萧鹏师兄能在加入武馆四个月内将虎形拳练至大成，并且猿形拳也至小成，再给他三个月的时候，猿形拳必然可以入大成之境。至于武道入品，以以萧师兄父亲萧万贯的财富，将他堆到武道入品再简单不过！”
这一刻，众人的目光瞬间转移至萧鹏身上。
此刻的萧鹏享受众人的目光，也满脸的意气风发。
content_en:
;;
Canglang Martial Arts School.
forecourt.
At this time, everyone exploded with Wang Jin's announcement.
"The Inspector's Mansion is actually true. I heard my father talk about it before, but I didn't expect it to be true!"
"This inspection office has too much power! It monitors all the people and patrols the world. It kills people first and reports later. Once you join, won't you immediately become a master?"
"That's natural! Once you join, you will definitely be a guest of all forces! Moreover, joining the Inspection Mansion will give you access to the supreme secrets of becoming a blood master and a spiritual master! You can even get guidance from that martial saint! This temptation is too great!"
"What's the use of being tempted? At the end of this year, all prefectures and counties must be established. The teacher even said that only those who have mastered the Five Birds Fist within three months and are qualified in martial arts are eligible to join. Can you do it? Or can I do it?"
"Yes! The teacher told us about this opportunity. He just wanted to encourage us to study martial arts hard and give us hope."
After the discussion, everyone suddenly became a little frustrated.
suddenly.
Someone said, "I know someone who has hope?"
"Who?"
"Senior Brother Cheng Ran!"
As soon as these words came out, everyone turned to look at Cheng Ran.
At this moment, Cheng Ran was smiling and seemed to be enjoying the attention of everyone.
The man continued: "Senior Brother Cheng Ran has already perfected his energy and blood, and both the crane and the tiger have reached a small level of success! It is not necessarily hopeless to achieve a breakthrough in boxing within three months, and it is not difficult for Senior Brother Cheng to reach the top level of martial arts!"
Hearing these words, everyone looked at Cheng Ran with a smile in surprise.
Just then.
A man in white loose training clothes, with a full head of black hair simply tied with a red tie, and an imposing man came out.
"Xiao Peng, I have met the teacher!" The man bowed slightly and saluted Wang Jin.
"What's the matter?" Wang Jin asked.
Xiao Peng cupped his hands and said: "This disciple has understood the spirit and form of the Tiger-shaped Fist a week ago. The Tiger-shaped Fist has reached the state of great success. Moreover, the Qi and blood have been greatly developed and will soon be perfected! The Ape-shaped Fist has also reached the state of small success."
As he spoke, Xiao Peng was in high spirits and the corners of his mouth were slightly raised.
At this moment, his body was full of energy and blood, and his body suddenly erupted with a faint aura, giving everyone around him a sense of oppression.
"Oh my God! Senior Brother Xiao has come this far without knowing it?" someone exclaimed.
"That's right! Senior Brother Xiao is really just silent. He's a blockbuster! He reached the mastery of Tiger Shape Fist a week ago, and yet he could hold back and didn't say it until today!"
"The tiger-shaped fist is a great success, the ape-shaped fist is a minor success, and the qi and blood penetrate the limbs. Doesn't this mean that the remaining spot has been locked in advance by senior brother Xiao Peng?"
"Looking at it from this point of view, although Senior Brother Cheng Ran has a chance, he is obviously slightly inferior. There is an insurmountable gap between a great master and a minor master in boxing!"
"That's right! Senior Brother Xiao Peng can practice the Tiger-Shaped Boxing to Dacheng and the Ape-shaped Fist to a minor level within four months of joining the martial arts school. Give him another three months and the Ape-shaped Fist will definitely be able to reach Dacheng. As for martial arts, with the wealth of Senior Brother Xiao's father, Xiao Wankuan, it's easy to get him to the martial arts!"
At this moment, everyone's attention instantly shifted to Xiao Peng.
At this moment, Xiao Peng was enjoying the attention of everyone, and his face was full of high spirits.
